q1: Is the initial consultation call truly free?
a1: Yes, our initial 30-minute scoping consultation is 100% free with zero obligation. It is designed to evaluate technical feasibility and scope fit.
q2: What will we cover during the call?
a2: We cover your growth goals, recommended tech stacks (Astro vs WordPress vs Next.js), technical SEO bottlenecks, competitor positioning, and realistic timelines.
q3: Can we arrange a video call or in-person review?
a3: Yes; after initial phone or messaging alignment, we can schedule a Google Meet video review or an in-person session in our regional hubs.
